     - For each starting index, check if the subsequence (P[i_1], P[i_1+1], ..., P[i_1+K-1]) can be rearranged into consecutive integers.

fix_code:
N, K = map(int, input().split())
P = list(map(int, input().split()))

ans = 100000000000

for i in range(N - K + 1):
    subsequence = P[i:i + K]
    if sorted(subsequence) == list(range(min(subsequence), min(subsequence) + K)):
        ans = min(ans, i + K - 1 - i)

print(ans)
